primary_endpoint: NASH resolution with no worsening of fibrosis at 72 weeks, assessed in patients with F2 or F3 fibrosis.
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution without fibrosis worsening occurred in 40%, 36%, and 59% with semaglutide 0.1, 0.2, and 0.4 mg, respectively, versus 17% with placebo (0.4 mg vs placebo, P<0.001). Fibrosis-stage improvement occurred in 43% versus 33% with 0.4 mg versus placebo (P=0.48).
safety_signal: Semaglutide 0.4 mg versus placebo: nausea 42% vs 11%, constipation 22% vs 12%, and vomiting 15% vs 2%. Across semaglutide groups, malignant neoplasms occurred in 3 patients (1%) versus none with placebo; overall neoplasms occurred in 15% versus 8%, without an organ-specific pattern.
